name: 托马斯·普莱辛格
name_full: 托马斯·普莱辛格 Thomas Plaichinger
birth_place: 德国 汉堡 萨尔茨堡
introduction: Born 1960 in SalzburgWas awarded the Förderpreis für Literatur by the city of Hamburg in 1989; Grant of the Ministry of Education and Art, Vienna 1991; grant of the Ministry of Vienna in 1994.Publications: 3 historical works (Edition Syros-Alternatives 1986, 1987, 1988); “Das Bild des Kometen” (Bielefeld 1989); “Mademoiselle im Hafen” (1989); “Der Mittelpunkt des Wartens” (1994); “Festland” (1995); “Jakob” (1997); Libretto for the opera “Triest” (Berliner Kammeroper, 1998).
